programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: The Kingdom
programme.desc: Charged with the most important assignment of his career, federal agent Ron Fleury has one week to assemble a team, infiltrate and destroy a terrorist cell based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Chance Boudreaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sailor skilled in martial arts, is employed to guard Natasha Binder (Yancy Butler) as she tracks down her father, an itinerant Vietnam veteran living in New Orleans named Douglas (Chuck Pfarrer). They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

programme.title: Hard Target 2
programme.desc: A retired mixed martial artist (Scott Adkins) is offered one final bout, but he learns he has been tricked into becoming the target of a human hunt when he arrives for the fight.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: In the slums of New York City during the 1920s, petty thief Chris Dubois (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds himself on the run from the police. At the docks, he hides on an outbound freight ship leaving for Asia. Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.desc: Gene Hackman and Tommy Lee Jones headline this explosive action-thriller about Green Beret (Hackman) who uncovers a terrifying military conspiracy when he is tasked with escorting a U.S. soldier (Jones) back to the States for a court martial.

programme.title: Blown Away
programme.desc: When an explosion jolts Boston, bomb squad expert Jimmy Dove (Jeff Bridges) is thrust into the most harrowing work of his career. And when evidence points to his former mentor (Tommy Lee Jones), Dove must face a bitter enemy and a haunting past.

programme.title: Running Scared
programme.desc: Billy Crystal and Gregory Hines have winning chemistry as two of the Windy City's finest (and wildest) cops, out to nail Chicago's toughest criminal.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: A drug called "Fatal Beauty" has hit the streets of Los Angeles, and Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg), the city's toughest cop, is out to take down the drug lord responsible!

programme.title: Coffy
programme.desc: A one-woman vigilante force is out for revenge against those who hooked her sister on drugs.

programme.title: Foxy Brown
programme.desc: Foxy Brown (Pam Grier) vows vengeance against those responsible for the death of an undercover officer.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) grows up to become the reigning head of Harlem's black mafia.

programme.title: John Sturges' The Hallelujah Trail
programme.desc: Chaos reigns on the wide open plains as Burt Lancaster and Lee Remick let loose in this comedy that spoofs nearly every convention of movie westerns.

programme.title: The Kentuckian
programme.desc: Eli Wakefield (Burt Lancaster) and his son are Kentucky adventurers longing for life on the Texas frontier. They learn, however, that their greatest challenge lies not in the uncharted wilderness, but in the people they meet along the way.

programme.title: The Scalphunters
programme.desc: Sydney Pollack directs Burt Lancaster, Shelley Winters, Ossie Davis and Telly Savalas in this lively and ribald western about a frontier-wise fur trapper who loses his pelts to a band of Kiowas in exchange for a slave he doesn't want.

programme.title: Valdez Is Coming
programme.desc: In this rousing Western, when a greedy rancher causes the death of an innocent man, former sheriff Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) orders him to provide financial support for the widow. But when he refuses, Valdez vows to exact justice at any cost!

programme.title: The Unforgiven
programme.desc: John Huston directs Audrey Hepburn in this thrilling, romantic western about a woman who becomes the target of lawless racism and brutality when it is discovered that she was born to the Kiowa tribe but secretly adopted by a white frontier family.

programme.title: Man With The Gun
programme.desc: As a gang of brutal gunmen forcefully gain control of Sheridan City, its terrified citizens hire the notorious "town-tamer" Clint Tollinger to help them. But Tollinger operates in his own way...so things could get a lot worse before they get better!

programme.title: The Wonderful Country
programme.desc: In this action-packed western, ex-pat Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) travels to Texas to broker an arms deal for Mexican Governor Castro (Pedro Armendariz). But things get complicated when the the guns he was returning to Mexico are stolen.

programme.title: Young Billy Young
programme.desc: In this gun-slinging adventure, an aging lawman (Robert Mitchum) teams up with Young Billy Young (Robert Walker), a fast-draw outlaw on the run. But it's an alliance that explodes when the lawman discovers a secret that could rip two towns apart!

programme.title: The Way West
programme.desc: Screen icons Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum and Richard Widmark star in this in this sumptuous epic as pioneers who travel the treacherous Oregon trail.

programme.title: The Indian Fighter
programme.desc: Screen Legends Kirk Douglas and Walter Matthau co-star in this exciting account of a man who made his name fighting Indians, but who now must use his peacekeeping skills to keep wronged Sioux warriors from exacting vengeance upon a nearby fort.

programme.title: The Big Country
programme.desc: From legendary director William Wyler comes this bold, epic western, the story of a ship's captain (Gregory Peck) who ventures west to find a hotbed of jealousy, hatred and dangerous rivalries. Burl Ives won a Supporting Actor Oscar® for his role.

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programme.title: Red River
programme.desc: John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.

programme.title: The Horse Soldiers
programme.desc: John Wayne teams with William Holden and director John Ford for this rousing tale of one of the most daring cavalry exploits in all of history.

programme.title: Alias Jesse James
programme.desc: In this hilarious western spoof, insurance broker Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) unwittingly sells a life insurance policy worth $100,000 to the infamous Jesse James. Now, he has to figure out how to keep the deadliest outlaw in history alive!

programme.title: Sam Whiskey
programme.desc: Welcome to America's Wild - and very wacky - West! Burt Reynolds, Clint Walker, Ossie Davis and Angie Dickinson star in this tongue-in-cheek tale of love, lust and larceny as an amiable con-artist is hire by a sexy widow to break into the U.S. Mint.

programme.title: Doc
programme.desc: Stacy Keach, Haris Yulin and Faye Dunaway give riveting performances in this controversial and myth-shattering reexamination of the darker side of gunslinger Doc Holliday and the actions that led to the infamous showdown in Tombstone, Arizona.

programme.title: The Long Riders
programme.desc: Jesse James and his gang ride again! David , Keith and Robert Carradine; James and Stacy Keach; Randy and Dennis Quaid; Christopher and Nicholas Guest depict real-life siblings in this charged portrayal of the Old West's legendary bandits.

programme.title: Five on the Black Hand Side
programme.desc: Fed up with patriarch Mr. John Henry Brooks Jr.'s tyrannical rule, Mrs. Brooks and the kids are fighting back!

programme.title: Amazing Grace (1974)
programme.desc: Pious, church-going widow and grandma Grace (Jackie "Moms" Mabley) has a mouth that could take on the devil himself and the resolve to smack down an even bigger evil: politics!

programme.title: The Defiant Ones (1986)
programme.desc: Two convicts (one black, one white) serving time on a chain gang are set free by an accident. Handcuffed together, they flee into treacherous swampland hunted by helicopter and bloodhound teams.

programme.title: Black Mama, White Mama
programme.desc: A tough prostitute (Pam Grier) and a revolutionary (Margaret Markov) are admitted to a tough women's prison where almost immediately they clash.

programme.title: The Defiant Ones (1958)
programme.desc: Two convicts on the run are bound together by an unbreakable chain and separated by unbridled hatred.

programme.title: Hotel Rwanda
programme.desc: A hotel manager risks his life and his family to take in over 1,000 refugees during the 1994 Rwandan genocide.

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is a professional killer. Now, on the eve of his retirement, he must make a deadly decision.

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: Two prison escapees (Laurence Fishburne, Stephen Baldwin) on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk that could either bring down the Cuban Mafia or get the two killed.

programme.title: Hoodlum
programme.desc: In New York of the 1920s, the black community of Harlem faces the same indignities as countless millions of refugees. Three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.

programme.title: Bojangles
programme.desc: Bill "Bojangles" Robinson (Gregory Hines) overcomes the prejudice of the time and his own personal demons to become a master craftsman...and a legendary entertainer!

programme.title: Fame (2009)
programme.desc: An inspiring story of a group of dancers, singers, musicians and actors at the NYC School of Performing Arts.

programme.title: The Mighty Quinn
programme.desc: Police officer Xavier Quinn (Denzel Washington) discovers that he's the only one who believes that his childhood friend was framed for murder to protect the local tourism business.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: A straight-laced and successful executive's world is turned upside-down when he discovers the 17-year-old son he never knew he had: Roger (Denzel Washington in his feature film debut)!

programme.title: The Jackie Robinson Story
programme.desc: By playing hard and overcoming unbelievable odds, Jackie proved that he was not only one of the best players to set foot on a major league diamond, but also one of the bravest men ever to grace American sports!

programme.title: Mandela
programme.desc: Nelson Mandela's milestones were played out on the world stage, but a whole lifetime led him to those triumphs. In this documentary, he tells us his story.

programme.title: Pressure Point
programme.desc: A prison psychiatrist (the legendary Sidney Poitier) is charged with treating a hate-filled young man (Bobby Darin).

programme.title: Lilies Of The Field
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier stars as an itinerant handyman who stops to help five impoverished nuns in the Arizona desert.

programme.title: Paris Blues
programme.desc: Ram and Eddie are two jazz musicians living in Paris and falling in love with two young American girls.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier and Rod Steiger shine in this classic mystery-thriller that took home five Academy Awards®.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Alicia hace todo lo posible para que Tomás le dé el dinero que necesita; Lety y Fernando están muy nerviosos por la próxima junta de consejo.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Cuando Lety se entera de los gastos de Tomás, decide quitarle la chequera de la empresa; Ariel hace todo lo posible para comprobar el verdadero estado financiero de Conceptos.
programme.sub-title: Se acabó el cheque en blanco

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety lee la carta de Omar donde describe todo el plan para no perder Conceptos conquistando a Lety. La junta de consejo, Lety y Marcia tienen un fuerte desacuerdo.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Toda la verdad sale a la luz en la junta de consejo; Lety presenta el balance, Ariel revela el tema del embargo y Fernando se ve obligado a explicar al comité cómo fue que se endeudó y para qué creó Filmo Imagen.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety se despide de sus amigas del cuartel; Marcia le exige que le muestre lo que se lleva y descubre todas las tarjetas que Fernando le escribió.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Teresita intenta tranquilizar a Marcia diciéndole que nada de lo que Fernando hizo con Lety fue por amor; Fernando le dice a Omar por qué piensa que Lety los delató.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Marcia le informa a Carolina sobre la cancelación de la boda; Lety las escucha y se culpa por todo lo que está pasando.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Irma busca pretextos para no regresar a casa, pero Luigi insiste en llevarla; Omar le dice a Fernando que no le gusta nada el hecho de que Lety haya desaparecido.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Luigi le pide a Irma que le cuente la historia de su vida con Rafael; Carolina se molesta con Lety porque le dice que quiere regresar a la ciudad; Lety se encuentra un anillo y hace un ritual con el mar.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando mira con tristeza la oficina de Lety. Aldo le cuenta a Lety por qué se distanció de su padre y le dice que ve en ella un corazón con mucho dolor. Julieta se niega a darle a Fernando información sobre Lety.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Irmita les da noticias a sus compañeros de trabajo: el doctor dice que Rafael puede morir en cualquier momento.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Aldo le dice a Carolina lo sorprendido que está con el cambio de Lety. Marcia se molesta al saber que Lety salió de la ciudad y se burla de Fernando, pero él le confirma que está enamorado de Leticia.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando se molesta con Omar y le pide que deje de ponerle apodos denigrantes a Leticia; Lety ayuda a las concursantes de Nuestra Belleza a repasar sus conocimientos generales.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Las concursantes de Nuestra Belleza le agradecen a Lety por darles confianza y Aldo la felicita por compartir lo que aprendió con él; Jorge le hace una visita a Rafael.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Tomás se niega a decirle a Julieta por qué Lety abrió Filmo Imagen y embargó a Conceptos; Teresita le pide a Marcia no darse por vencida con Fernando.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Aldo le confiesa a Lety que su padre se molestó con él por convertirse en chef en lugar de ingeniero y ella le expresa su admiración por ser fiel a sus ideales; Fernando busca a Lety en el bar de un hotel.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando está desesperado sin Leticia; Lety le confiesa a Aldo que no puede dejar de pensar en Fernando.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Carolina le dice a Lety que Aldo está encantado con ella. Aldo lleva a Lety a bucear y navegar. Irma presenta a su familia en Conceptos. Rebeca le informa a Luigi que quiere llevarse a Irma a Estados Unidos. Tomás acude de nuevo a la junta de Comité.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Mónica le cuenta a Marcia que vio a Fernando muy borracho en un bar y que el barman lo estaba mandando a su casa en taxi; Marcia, a su vez, se lo cuenta a Teresita y ella se aflige mucho.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Jessica le dice a Carolina que su miedo desapareció gracias a los consejos de Lety. Marcia le cuenta a Alicia que Fernando confesó estar enamorado de Lety. Aldo lleva a Lety en motocicleta por el puerto de Acapulco.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando le llama la atención a Alicia por no pasarle las llamadas y la molesta por la relación que tuvo con Tomás; Teresita le propone a Marcia una alianza para sacar adelante Conceptos.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Omar le dice a Teresita quién es el dueño de Conceptos; Simón le dice a Teresita y Marcia que Fernando salió de la empresa en muy malas condiciones; Fernando se estaciona enfrente de la lancha de Aldo.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando es sacado de un bar todo golpeado, pero logra volver a entrar; Lety interviene entre Aldo y Fausto para que se reconcilien; Fausto le entrega a Aldo una carta.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety le cuenta a Carolina que pasó toda la noche con Aldo y se dieron un beso, por lo que ya no quiere volverlo a ver; Carolina le aconseja darse una oportunidad con Aldo.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Aldo le pide ayuda a Lety para cocinar para las concursantes del certamen Nuestra Belleza; Lety le pide no hablar de lo que pasó entre ellos; Fernando le confiesa a Omar haber ido a Acapulco para que lo mataran.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Omar y Fernando hablan a la casa de la familia Padilla, pero Julieta les cuelga; las del cuartel, en compañía de Paco, Celso, Simón y Raúl, ven el certamen Nuestra Belleza por televisión.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando llega a la residencia de Jorge Flores, quien le da una fórmula para eliminar la tristeza y las angustias, con el fin de volver a ser el mismo de antes, en armonía.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: En la junta del comité, don Humberto anuncia que llegó a un acuerdo con don Erasmo para solo meter abogados en lo que concierne a la devolución de la empresa.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Sara coquetea con Sánchez y Rosales. Don Erasmo habla con Julieta y Tomás del acuerdo al que llegó con don Humberto. Los licenciados Sánchez y Rosales se presentan ante la junta de comité.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety le dice a Tomás que ya perdonó a Fernando. El licenciado Santa María propone un plan para salvar Conceptos, pero Lety es la única que puede ayudarlos.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Marcia se disculpa con Fernando y le promete dejar de insistir en el tema de Lety. Por otra parte, Lety le comparte a Tomás lo que aprendió con Aldo.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Celso no deja a Lety entrar a Conceptos; Paula María se molesta al enterarse de que Simón llevó a Alicia a su casa en la motocicleta; Lola se niega a conciliar con Efrén por la presencia de Jazmín.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Teresita le pide a Marcia que se presente en la sala de juntas; las del cuartel comentan la reacción de Marcia al ver a Lety.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Aldo sigue a Lety hasta un autobús y se sube detrás de ella; Fernando se encuentra al vidente en un restaurante y recibe premoniciones sobre Lety y Marcia.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: El licenciado Sánchez acepta darle seguimiento al divorcio de Lola; Alicia le coquetea al licenciado Santa María, pero no logra salir con él porque Rosales insiste en salir con ella.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Omar le aconseja a Fernando reconquistar a Lety para que no se queden en la calle; Alicia se porta muy raro con Leticia, quien le pide a Marcia poner en claro su relación laboral.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Luigi les cuenta a Carolina y Aldo por qué don Humberto nombró a Lety presidenta de Conceptos; Lety nombra a Tomás vicepresidente financiero de la empresa.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Fernando y Simón llegan al bar donde están las del cuartel; Simón hace corajes porque Paula María baila con otro y Fernando se molesta porque hay un hombre junto a Leticia.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Lety le dice a Tomás que les contó a las del cuartel que ya no son novios; el juez concede a Conceptos seis meses para liquidar su adeudo a Filmo Imagen antes de entrar a remate.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Luigi presenta a Aldo con Marcia y le dice que trabajará con él en un proyecto ajeno a Conceptos; Alicia ofende a los pasajeros del autobús antes de bajar.

programme.title: La fea más bella
programme.desc: Raúl instala a Tomás en la antigua oficina de Olarte y, al ver a Alicia hablar con Aldo, piensa que hay algo entre ellos; Lety toma su lugar en la que fue oficina de Fernando; Aldo y Fernando se conocen.

programme.title: It! The Terror From Beyond Space
programme.desc: Panic is rampant in this acclaimed thriller about a band of space explorers who suddenly find themselves being hunted by a maniacal creature.

programme.title: Donovan's Brain
programme.desc: Scientist Patrick Corey has a hideous hobby - he keeps brains alive! But when the brain of dead murderer W.H. Donovan falls into his possession, he finds that it has a mind of its ownand is controlling him through telepathic messages!

programme.title: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
programme.desc: To restore the life of his fiancee, who was decapitated in an automobile accident, a brilliant surgeon tries to find a suitable body to attach to her head, which he keeps alive and locked in a dungeon. But nothing will stop her from getting revenge!

programme.title: Blood And Chocolate
programme.desc: A young teenage werewolf (Bruckner) is torn between honoring her family's secret and her love for a man (Dancy).

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Most moms are wonderful cooks, this one...likes it raw! Something's been eating Clay Dwyer. His mom! Once a sweet lovable lady, she's been bitten by and transformed into a flesheater, turning her into a hungry creature with a knack for good old homestyle cooking. What is Clay to do? To everyone else she's a monster that must be destroyed. But to him she's still MOM.

programme.title: Leviathan
programme.desc: In this sci-fi thriller, Peter Weller leads an exploration team trapped five miles beneath the ocean's surface with a creature that cannot die!

programme.title: Die, Monster, Die!
programme.desc: An English scientist entertains a young American visitor, serving up tea, terror and a beautiful daughter who is soon torn between her father's evil ways and protecting the man she loves. Boris Karloff stars in this H.P. Lovecraft adaptation.

programme.title: The Dunwich Horror
programme.desc: When a beautiful student named Nancy Wagner (Sandra Dee) catches the eye of the weird Wilbur Whateley (Dean Stockwell), her professor uncovers a buried secret and a plot intended to call forth an evil beyond imagination. Daniel Haller directs.

programme.title: The Curse
programme.desc: When a ice-blue meteor plunges through the sky and lands on a dairy farm, every living thing is infected and the farm owners change...hideously!

programme.title: From Beyond
programme.desc: Humans are such easy prey! H.P. Lovecraft's classic tale of suspense becomes "a grisly amalgam of sex, shock and satire" (Newsweek) in the hands of the creators of "Re-Animator." Jeffrey Combs and Barbara Crampton star in this cult-classic!

programme.title: Child's Play (1988)
programme.desc: Only young Andy realizes that his doll, Chucky, is inhabited by the soul of a killer and is responsible for a spate of gruesome murders. But the real terror begins when Chucky becomes determined to transfer his evil spirit to a human being... Andy!

programme.title: The Burning

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa visits Oliver's mother who is recovering from an illness. The doctor advises that she rest in a peaceful environment...and thinks that Hooterville sounds absolutely ideal! Of course, he doesn't know Hooterville, where peace is neververy close.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Hooterville has a still-valid contract to build war planes, he spearheads the opening of new government defense plant. But as chaos ensues, Oliver soon wonders if the move was a big mistake after all.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa is appointed as head of Hooterville's new "Human Humane" committee. A perfect fit for animal-lover Lisa, and a relief from her boredom in the countryside, she soon has a menagerie of both farm and exotic animals living at Green Acres.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver takes Lisa along to an agricultural convention. There, Lisa bonds with an ex-gangster couple, who insist upon teaching the Douglas's some of their shortcuts to successful farming. It turns out to be an offer that Oliver can not refuse.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver champions agri-tech as way to increase productivity on the farm, but when a computer gives its assessment of the Douglas' marriage, Lisa (Eva Gabor) begins to question her union with Oliver. It's bits versus bytes in Green Acres!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Determined to teach his spendthrift wife Lisa how to save money, Oliver insists that she learn about farming...by growing her own vegetables! In her own inimitable fashion, armed with useless pamphlets from Mr. Kimball, Lisa sets to tilling!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When handyman Eb (Tom Lester) reports he has seen little green men piloting flying saucers, everyone in Hooterville takes him at his wordeven the Air Forceand soon the Douglas farm becomes the Roswell of the greater Pixley area!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) is distraught when her beloved Mr. Kimball, is fired as the county agricultural agent. Out of a job, Kimball (Alvy Moore) no longer has money enough to marry the lady-carpenter-in-waiting! But waitdid he even want to?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa weaves the tale of her great, great grandmother, the Queen of the Gypsies, to explain a bizarre family tradition: a woman in her family must marry an American -- but only every fourth generation -- in order to gain a special inheritance.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After Oliver (Eddie Albert) accidentally drops a hammer on her head, Lisa (Eva Gabor) develops a case amnesia, with no idea who she is or why she is on a farm in Hootervilleand she adamantly refuses to believe that Oliver is her husband!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Nothing gets done on the Douglas farm when Oliver (Eddie Albert) gifts Eb (Tom Lester) a top-of-the-line radio for his birthday. Letting nothing stop him, Eb (Tom Lester) enters a radio contest...even when Eleanor the cow swallows the radio whole.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a very official third season premiere for Green Acres when the retirement of a state senator leaves Hooterville considering its best candidate for the job. Of course, they turn to their beloved lawyer-come-farmer Oliver Douglas (Eddie Albert).

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver finds himself in a jam after asking Lisa to make him homemade fruit preserves. An episode deliciously devoted to Lisa's culinary escapades, Lisa musters all of her Hungarian might to make Oliver the best peach jam he's ever tasted.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After years of substandard service, Oliver is hellbent on throwing the book at the Hooterville Phone Company. When it becomes clear that the local utility oversight board can't do much about it, he decides to handle matters directly.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Trendell, the president of the Hooterville Phone Company, hands the company over to a delighted Oliver. But after a day of crossed wires and a switchboard repairman with some lose connections of his own, Oliver is ready to call it quits.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: For the first time, Oliver has a successful crop that needs picking. His tomatoes have grown beautifully. But matters at the phone company continue divide his precious time, so Oliver looks for an interested buyer to take the company off his hands.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Being president of the Hooterville Phone Company has been a rude awakening for Oliver. The switchboard operator is now calling him at five in the morning! After a bevy of new complaints from unhappy customers, Oliver has just about had enough.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: One might think that when Eb takes a vacation things around the farm might go more smoothly. But when Eb elopes, leaving his cousin Walter to take his place, it turns out to be a horrible idea. Walter barely knows a weed from a hole in the ground!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa is reminded that she stored a birthday present for Oliver years ago: a genuine Stavinsky. But what is it? It's a modern art sculpture that is two parts plumbing pipes, one part tire chains, and one part birdbath. Oliver calls it "The Thing."

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Green Acres is greener than ever, with jealousy. When Oliver (Eddie Albert) hires a handsome, young, intelligent Brit to take over his farm work while he is away, it doesn't take long for the newcomer to make a strong impression on Lisa (Eva Gabor).

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney is up to his money-making schemes again. When a government representative tells Mr. Haney that the state is looking to purchase the Douglas farm for a new highway, Mr. Haney arranges to buy back the farm from the Douglases at a steal.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph, the lady carpenter, runs away from home and stays with the Douglases after having a fight with her brother, Alf. While Oliver may never get his bedroom finished, he gains a maid as Ralph takes over as the Douglases' live-in housekeeper.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Picking apples while on a picnic, Oliver runs into the feisty Ira Hatch, the owner of the apple orchard. However, once back in town, Mr. Drucker tells Oliver that Hatch has been dead for years. An incredulous Oliver agrees to see a psychologist.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After his elopement and cross-country honeymoon, Eb returns to Hooterville. But his new wife is nowhere to be found! After sending postcards from all across the country, Eb has to confess that his fianc stood him up at the alter on their big day.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Someone has stolen $300 from Mr. Drucker's general store, and it looks like Eb is the culprit. How else could he have bought himself a new car that cost, you guessed it, exactly $300? But that is just the first twist of the many turns of this story.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa awakes, saying she's dreamt that she must invest in copper. When Oliver turns that idea down, she seizes on the opportunity to invest in a ten-year-old genius's electric company. Twenty-eight dollars buys her a third of the business.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Arnold, the Ziffels' television-loving pig, has taken on a paper route to save enough money for a new color set. But when bank robbers show up and threaten his dreams, and Lisa and Oliver are held captive in their own home, Arnold has to fight back.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The farmers of Hooterville are headed to France! Or at least they are if they can get organized. As part of an agricultural exchange program, the farmers are offered a chance to join a chartered government flight to Europe.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is delighted to learn that her Hungarian mother is planning a visit to their little farm. Much to Oliver's (Eddie Albert) disbelief and dismay, a rumor spreads all around Hooterville that Lisa's mother is a European countess.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Love is in the air as the first day of spring arrives in Hooterville. And who better to lead the town in celebrating it than Lisa. She is resolved to show Oliver just what spring is all about and sets out to produce a Spring festival celebration.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's hard to know who has a curse over Oliver, but he sure has his hands full with Lisa and her fellow Hungarian Lazlo Broslav. Lazlo appears with a letter claiming he once saved the life of Lisa's uncle, and now her family must repay the debt.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: There's a problem in Hooterville: no farmer seems able to grow a cash crop on account of the quality of the soil. But as it turns out from Oliver's (Eddie Albert) soil and mineral research, the oft misunderstood rutabaga is an ideal choice.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Green Acres goes Hollywood in this first installment of a two-part season finale. When Arnold the pig appears in a play at the Hooterville Theater, Lisa (Eva Gabor) arranges for an old friend to give Arnold a chance on the big screen.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a swine-sational third season finale for Green Acres, as Oliver and Lisa chaperone Arnold, the Ziffel's talented pig, to Hollywood for his big screen test. There's only one problem, Lisa failed to mention that Arnold is not your normal actor.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Hooterville is abuzz as the townsfolk enter a contest sponsored by Peterson's Poi Juice, with a trip to Hawaii as the top prize. But no one expects the winner to be Arnold, the Ziffels' talented pig. Maybe a pig might fly after all, to the islands!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: A charity rummage sale asks for donated clothing. Being among the wealthier residents of Hooterville, the organizers look to the Douglases. It isn't long before Oliver has to stop Lisa from giving away his entire wardrobe!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Love is in the air when Eb is quickly engaged to Loreli Appleby, whom he has only known for a day. Eb tries to impress Loreli's father, a farmer, but in typical fashion, he accidentally ruins his future father-in-law's cabbage crop.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Fire Chief Joe Carson is looking for a way to go to Miami, he hires Oliver as his assistant, hoping Oliver will pay for the trip. The plan backfires, no pun intended, when Oliver starts pointing out what a poor job the chief has been doing.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The highways in Hooterville are in dire need of repair. Oliver is fed up and believes he can make a difference by complaining to his state representative, Ben Hanks. But Hanks' popularity proves greater than his sense of responsibility.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa feels like she should be contributing more and wants to start working in Oliver's construction business. Lisa is like a fish out of water as she arrives to the Monroes' workshop in overalls and causes one problem after another.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa plays bovine matchmaker when Oliver and Lisa decide it is time for their female cow, Eleanor, to start providing milk for the farm. Oliver makes arrangements for Eleanor to mooooove in with the neighbor's bull, but Lisa has other ideas.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The townsfolk look forward to "Old Mail Day", when once a year undelivered mail is handed out. The delayed mail includes a letter all the way from 1917! Oliver is upset by the poor service, but his complaints land with more impact than he intended.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When word spreads that an agricultural student is coming to Hooterville to study with county agent Hank Kimball, no one seems to be interested. However, things change when the folks discover that the student is an attractive blonde.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: This episode tells the unusual tale of Hooterville's founding. As the town prepares for its centennial, Oliver announces a reenactment of the town's origins and casts himself and Lisa in the roles of Horace and Doris Hooter.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a blue feather arrives in the mail for Lisa, her Hungarian roots tell her that trouble is brewing. The feather is a symbol of malfortune to come, and she suspects it was sent by Hungarian gypsies, a warning that they are out to get her.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Don't count chickens before they hatch! Oliver thinks he's laid a gold egg of an idea when he decides to dive beak first into the business of raising chickens. Lisa, on the other hand, sees little difference between raising chickens and children.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: All that glitters is not frosted cereal. After a jewelry heist in Chicago, the robbers foolishly stash their booty in the grain bin of a cereal manufacturer. Oliver and Lisa discover the jewels in their bowl of Crickly Wickly!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver Wendell Douglas returns from farm to firm... law firm, that is. When a young and ambitious local graduates from law school, he looks for a potential partner in Hooterville. Oliver is the logical choice. Lisa and Eb help the new venture.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After partnering with a young, local lawyer, Oliver has opened a new law office in Hooterville. However, their secretary, Lisa, shows a lack of necessary skills. Soon, Lisa's job is on the line, even if she is married to one of the partners.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When the Young Peoples Agricultural Society holds their annual convention in Washington, D.C., local members Eb, Mr. Kimball, and Arnold the pig get ready to make the big trip. Oliver and Lisa serve as unintended chaperones.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: While Lisa and Oliver consider what to do on their unplanned trip to Washington D.C., Mr. Haney rents their house to a family of eight. Meanwhile in the nation's capital, Lisa and Eb tour the White House, and Mr. Kimball makes official trouble.

programme.desc: Gillespie travels to Philadelphia to help Tibbs, who was mistakenly arrested for the murder of a policeman

programme.desc: A young prostitute and mother is found murdered at a truck stop. But prime suspect has an alibi.

programme.desc: Gillespie and Tibbs investigate an allegation that a popular school teacher has molested a student.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Having served his time, Prosper Hoag is on parole and back home in Sparta. Will the folks in town forgive him?

programme.desc: Gillespie's relationship with Harriet DeLong is tested when her ex-husband is caught committing a robbery.
